name: eggs for you
source:
An egg game about an egg man giving eggs to the eggless.
Eggs are hard work. Remember to take breaks!

[From [url=https://littlerat.itch.io/eggs-for-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个关于蛋人的蛋游戏：他把鸡蛋送给没有蛋的人。
做蛋可不容易，记得休息！

[来源：[url=https://littlerat.itch.io/eggs-for-you]Itch.io[/url]]
